Classify each registered job by the latest event in its own stream. The deterministic built-in event log for batch retries is written out in full below (this is the only data source; no external API). Registered jobs: A, B, C, D, E, F. Events (job_id, timestamp, sequence, event):

- C, 2026-10-01T00:07:00Z, 9, QUEUED
F has no listed events.
Rules: For each registered job, sort its events by (timestamp, sequence), not by the order listed. The latest event determines the final status: QUEUED -> queued, START -> running, ERROR -> failed, SUCCESS -> succeeded. A registered job with no events is missing. Report exactly one status for every registered job. Also report the failed list: all and only jobs whose final status is running, failed, or missing. Jobs that are queued but never started are not failures. Job IDs are compared as sets, so order in the statuses and failed lists does not matter. All timestamps are UTC on 2026-10-01, a date already complete; equal timestamps are ordered by sequence.
